messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-03-11, the ledger service has a deploy freeze from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 for the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-11]
- As of 2025-11-11, the billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 for the peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]
- On 2026-05-28 the Ember team noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-28]
- The ledger service relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down. [valid 2025-03-04 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-04]
- As of 2025-08-25, the ledger service only ships on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC; the previous weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC slot is retired. [constraint; valid 2025-08-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-08-25]
    earlier: The ledger service only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-01-14 to 2025-08-25; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-14]
- The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- As of 2025-08-25, the ledger service deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-08-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-08-25]
- On 2026-05-27 the Atlas team noticed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- On 2026-04-14 the Dune team noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14-2]
- On 2026-04-16 the Atlas team noticed that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change and flagged it because it is not their service. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16]
- The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings. [valid 2025-01-09 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2]
- Lena is the release captain for Q1 2026. [valid 2025-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-22]
- As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder instead of the Atlas team. [valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
- As of 2026-02-03, the Atlas team has a no-deploy Friday. [decision; valid 2026-02-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-02-03]
- As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the previous Tuesdays 13:00-15:00 UTC slot is retired. [constraint; valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19]
    earlier: Deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC and at no other time. [constraint; valid 2025-02-06 to 2025-08-19; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-06]
- Per the 2026-04-14 Dune team standup, Farah is release captain for Q3 2025. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14-3]
- Dashboards and alerts for the event bus are being repointed as of the 2025-11-24 handover. [valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
- Dashboards and alerts for the image resizer are being repointed as of the 2025-11-26 handover. [valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
- Dashboards and alerts for the product catalog are being repointed as of the 2025-12-19 handover. [valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
- The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so if the bus is down the notifier is down. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-11]
